ability.name: Step 1 — Determine Local Network Ranges
ability.description: Dynamically calculate active subnets based on physical/logical interfaces to restrict discovery activities to standard subnets.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $cidrs = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254.*' } | ForEach-Object { $ip = $_.IPAddress; $pl = $_.PrefixLength; $b = ([System.Net.IPAddress]$ip).GetAddressBytes(); $mk = [System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$pl))); if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($mk) }; $net = (0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; "$net/$pl" } | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($cidrs) { $cidrs | Out-File "$d/network_cidrs.txt" -Encoding ascii; $cidrs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "CIDR: $_" } } else { throw "No active subnets found" } } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step1_subnet_discovery $($_.Exception.Message)" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/network_cidrs_out.txt

rationale: Dynamically determine local ranges directly from native routing and interfaces without hardcoding.
